title: Delay loading, by hand
description:
Resolve a function the first time it is called, the way delay loading does.

```
first call to compress(): loading zlib... resolved
second call: already resolved
zlib missing: compress() falls back to "store without compressing"
```
hints: Inside the resolver: `++loads; compress = zlibPresent ? realCompress : storeOnly; return compress(s);` (lesson 4.03).
Real delay loading does the same with a stub in the import table, filled in by `__delayLoadHelper2`.
requirements: A function pointer that starts as a "resolver" stub; the stub finds the real function, stores it, and calls it.
When the module is missing, store a fallback instead and log once.
Count how many times the "load" happens (it must be once).
